name: naoj-saturn-occultations-2024-2025
source_description: NAOJ lunar-occultation prediction form (Local Prediction), saved for the four Saturn events of 2024 November to 2025 February, for Tokyo.
transcription_note: Saved NAOJ Local Prediction pages. For a visible event NAOJ prints the per-event circumstances as an HTML table (time zone JCST, UT+9); for a site that misses the event it prints only the words 'Not Visible'. Unlike the Jupiter snapshot, the visible event's contact times here are machine-readable text, so they are captured; the map figure is not OCR'd. 'status' is NAOJ's own wording; 'is_visible' is the boolean this project reads from it.

project_solver_least_distance.note: This project's own solver, using the elements as transcribed (D0 sign corrected to -8.50266 on 2026-10-20). Recorded so that the sign error found by line 2026-10-20 cannot silently return: with D0 positive the same code reports 09:18:37 UT and +60.80 deg.
